clues.title: Plate: red strip
text: Licence plates in Kyrgyzstan have a **red strip** on them.
NOTE: Licence plates with red strips can sometimes be seen in Albania and very rarely in the UAE.

images.caption: Kyrgyz plates: standard and 2015 onwards, with a red strip

clues.summary: Plates have a red strip on them. Albania has red strips on plates too, and the UAE very rarely.

differs.how: Only very rarely has red strips

clues.title: Google car: silver car with four roof bars
text: Kyrgyzstan can be recognised from the **silver car** and **four bars** that are visible. All coverage is Generation 3.
NOTE: No other country with a similar landscape has a similar Street View car.
clues.summary: A silver car with four visible roof bars, all Gen 3. No other country with a similar landscape has a similar car.

clues.title: Language: Cyrillic with Ө, Ү and Ң
text: The Kyrgyz script is similar to Russian. However, the Cyrillic script used for Kyrgyz includes additional characters not found in Russian Cyrillic, such as:
- Ө
- Ү
- Ң
clues.summary: The script looks like Russian but adds the letters Ө, Ү and Ң, which Russian does not have.

clues.title: Season: winter, bare trees, snow
text: All of Kyrgyzstan was covered during the **winter months**, so many of the trees will lack leaves, the landscape will be quite drab, and you can see snow in many parts of Kyrgyzstan.
clues.summary: Everything was covered in winter, so trees are mostly bare, the land looks drab and you often see snow.

clues.title: Poles: trees and poles painted white at the base
text: In Kyrgyzstan, you will often see trees and concrete poles that are **painted white** on the bottom.

images.caption: Tree trunks and a pole painted white at the base; red circles mark the painted bases

clues.summary: Tree trunks and concrete poles are often painted white at the bottom.

clues.title: Bollard: white with a diagonal black stripe
text: Kyrgyzstan uses these simple white bollards with a diagonal black stripe near the top.
clues.summary: Simple white bollards with a diagonal black stripe near the top.

clues.title: Kilometre marker: red-and-white triangle pattern
text: These kilometre markers with a **red-and white** triangle pattern are unique to Kyrgyzstan.

images.caption: A drawn red-and-white kilometre marker post, number 59, placed over a roadside photo

clues.summary: Kilometre markers with a red-and-white triangle pattern are unique here, though Kazakhstan has similar ones near one town.

differs.how: Only seen near one Kazakh town

clues.title: Buildings: many mosques
text: The majority of Kyrgyzstan’s population is Muslim. Hence, you will see a lot of **mosques** throughout the country.
clues.summary: Most people are Muslim, so you see lots of mosques across the country.

clues.title: Coverage: very limited, learn the covered roads
text: The coverage in Kyrgyzstan is very limited. So learning which roads are covered will help you improve a lot.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
clues.summary: Coverage is very limited, so learning which roads are covered helps a lot.

clues.title: Google car: driving direction on main roads
text: Learning which direction the Google Car is driving on most major roads will help you narrow down your options when guessing.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
clues.summary: Knowing which way the car drives on each major road helps narrow your guess.

clues.title: Google car: mirror shows less road in the south
text: You can use the Google car’s mirror to region-guess Kyrgyzstan. In the southern region, **less of the road is visible** on the mirror. The car’s reflection is more diagonal. For comparison, this is what it usually [looks like](https://goo.gl/maps/hcZKoj5RDCHUQvpR8).

images.caption: Red circles zoom in on the car's mirror visible at the left of the blur

clues.summary: The car's mirror hints at the region. In the south less of the road shows in the mirror and the car's reflection is more diagonal.

clues.title: Google car: dirt on the mirror
text: Within this southern region, west of the roundabout that takes you up to Manas (Previously Jalal-Abad), the mirror will have a varying degree of **dirt** on it.
clues.summary: In the south, west of the roundabout going up to Manas (formerly Jalal-Abad), the mirror has varying amounts of dirt on it.

clues.title: Google car: small black dot on the mirror
text: If you see a **small black dot** on the Kyrgyzstan car mirror, you will be in this region.

images.caption: Red circles zoom in on the small black dot on the car's side mirror

clues.summary: A small black dot on the car's mirror points to a specific set of roads, mostly in the north.

clues.title: Roads: divided roads near the capital
text: **Divided roads** are mostly concentrated in and around the capital, Bishkek. A major divided highway runs from Bishkek to Balykchy in the east.
NOTE: The cities marked on the map also have at least one divided road.
clues.summary: Divided roads are mostly around the capital, with a major divided highway running east to Balykchy. A few other cities have at least one divided road.

clues.title: Landscape: big lake, no mountains beyond
text: Lake Issyk Kul is the **biggest body of water** in Kyrgyzstan. You will often be able to spot it on the roads north and south of the lake. Sometimes it will be obscured by buildings or trees, but the lack of any mountains in the direction of the lake will be a good clue.

NOTE: There are two other significant bodies of water that can be seen from the road: the [Toktogul Reservoir](https://goo.gl/maps/ay9ZJWwV3ZNPLviu6) and [Lake Song-Kul](https://goo.gl/maps/zgw4obnegxGGkWSPA). With a bit of practice, you can reliably distinguish these from Issyk Kul however.

images.caption: Two views of a large lake shore with flat grassland; compass icons show the facing direction

clues.summary: The biggest lake can often be seen from roads to its north and south. If buildings hide it, a gap with no mountains in that direction is a good clue. Two other big waters, a reservoir and Lake Song-Kul, are also visible from roads.

clues.title: Google car: snowy northern roads, bright sky
text: These northern roads have a considerable amount of **snow**, and the sky is generally bright.
The individual sections of these roads are discussed in more detail in step 3.
NOTE: There is also snow coverage in the south. However, you can use the mirror to distinguish these roads.
clues.summary: The northern roads have lots of snow and a generally bright sky. The south also has snow, but the mirror tells them apart.

clues.title: City: taller multi-storey buildings
text: As the capital city of Kyrgyzstan, Bishkek is by far the most developed city, featuring many taller **multi-story** buildings you would not see elsewhere. And on the outskirts, you can see [fancier buildings ](https://goo.gl/maps/xd7MyxMkqN71PgQs8)as well. There are also [mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/tJvLR8okRKxPUMvx6) south of Bishkek, but these can be hard to see at times.
clues.summary: The capital is by far the most developed city, with many tall buildings and fancier houses on the edges. Mountains lie to the south, though hard to see.

clues.title: Coverage: snow in a city region
text: You can find **urban snow coverage** in this region of Bishkek.
clues.summary: Urban snow coverage can be found in this part of the capital.

clues.title: Landscape: hilly, snowy mountains south
text: The coverage south of Bishkek is generally a bit hilly, and you will see the **snowy Tian Shan mountains** to the south. And as Bishkek has the most polluted air of any city, there will usually be visible **smog** to the north.
clues.summary: South of the capital is a bit hilly with snowy Tian Shan mountains to the south. The city has very polluted air, so usually you see smog to the north.

clues.title: Pole: colourful yellow, green, white
text: These towns east and west of Bishkek feature these **colourful poles** with yellow, green, white, and sometimes red on top.
NOTE: Sokuluk will not have the red paint on top.

images.caption: A pole painted yellow, green and white, zoomed in the left circle

clues.summary: Towns east and west of the capital have poles painted yellow, green, white and sometimes red on top. One town has no red.

clues.title: Google car: southern mirror, never fully overcast
text: Osh is the second-biggest city in Kyrgyzstan. It is one of several towns that has coverage with the **southern mirror**. This allows you to easily distinguish it from Bishkek.
The weather in Osh is fairly good, with some clouds, but **never fully overcast**.

NOTE: Manas (Previously Jalal-Abad), the other big city with the southern mirror, will always have [very overcast coverage](https://www.google.com/maps/@?api=1&map_action=pano&pano=lb_vnjE_MggaJRTpdjrO4A&viewpoint=40.932859%2C72.985991&heading=79.44492827377147&pitch=42.14790148445914&fov=133.1640120049908#extra%5BloadMode%5D=latLng).
clues.summary: The second biggest city has the southern mirror, which separates it from the capital. The weather is fairly good with some clouds but never fully overcast.

clues.title: Vegetation: trees still have leaves
text: You can also distinguish Osh from Bishkek by looking at the trees: most still have their **leaves**.
clues.summary: In the second biggest city most trees still have leaves, unlike the capital.

clues.title: Landscape: odd mountain with radio masts on top
text: In the centre of Osh, you can see these **unique mountains** with radio masts on top of them.
clues.summary: In the centre of the second biggest city there are unusual mountains with radio masts on top.

clues.title: Google car: southern mirror, completely overcast
text: Manas (Previously Jalal-Abad) is the third-biggest city in Kyrgyzstan. Like Osh, its coverage has the **southern mirror**.
You can recognise it from the **extremely overcast coverage**, with no gaps in the clouds. This allows you to easily distinguish it from Osh, which has better weather.
To the east, you can see this [slightly snowy hill](https://goo.gl/maps/ZUZ7tn1pTEmFmeF3A).
clues.summary: The third biggest city has the southern mirror and totally overcast shots with no gaps in the clouds. To the east there is a slightly snowy hill.

clues.title: Landscape: snowy town in the mountains
text: Arslanbob is a **snowy** town north of Manas (Previously Jalal-Abad), with hills and mountains all around. As the town is located in the mountains, you can see a lot of **elevation change** inside the town.
NOTE: The town also features the southern mirror.

images.caption: Snowy village street; the circled inset zooms in on a detail of the Google car's mirror.

clues.summary: A snowy mountain resort town north of Manas with hills all around and lots of elevation change inside the town. It also has the southern mirror.

clues.title: Coverage: slightly snowy, overcast town
text: Uzgen is a **slightly snowy** town between Osh and Manas (Previously Jalal-Abad), which features **overcast** coverage.
NOTE: The town also features the southern mirror.
clues.summary: A slightly snowy town between Osh and Manas with overcast coverage and the southern mirror.

clues.title: Pole: white bottom with red and yellow stripes
text: In Talas, most poles are painted white on the bottom, and feature **red and yellow** stripes.

images.caption: A pole with a white bottom and red and yellow stripes, zoomed in the red circle

clues.summary: Most poles in the western city of Talas are white at the bottom with red and yellow stripes.

clues.title: Landscape: city between snowy mountains, sunny
text: Karakol is a city located between snow capped mountains to the north and south. The coverage in the city is **sunny**, and you can see **melting snow** on the ground.
clues.summary: A sunny city between snow-capped mountains to the north and south, with melting snow on the ground. This is Karakol in the east.

clues.title: Landscape: orange ridge north, snow south
text: Naryn features a steep **orange ridge** to the north, and big snow capped mountains to the south.
clues.summary: A steep orange ridge to the north and large snow-capped mountains to the south point to Naryn.

clues.title: Coverage: distinct sunset on the road
text: You can notice a distinct **sunset** on all the coverage from Sokuluk to Kara Balta.
NOTE: This section of road features the Black Dot Mirror.
clues.summary: A clear sunset runs through all the coverage from Sokuluk to Kara Balta. This stretch has the black dot mirror.

clues.title: Landscape: flat land, range to the south
text: Here, you will see the Tian Shan **mountain range** to the south. The landscape is otherwise **flat**. The further away from the mountains you are, the [foggier](https://goo.gl/maps/8kUk6rSVFqKD7CoEA) they seem.
NOTE: This section of road features the Black Dot Mirror.
clues.summary: Flat land with the Tian Shan range to the south, which looks foggier the further you are. This stretch has the black dot mirror.

clues.title: Landscape: purple-red rocky cliffs
text: The mountains here can be characterised by **steep rocky cliffs** that can have a slight **purple or red** tint to them. Not much vegetation grows on these mountains - only some grass and shrubs. A small river also runs alongside the road. You can also spot these [brown metallic electricity pylons](https://goo.gl/maps/oscB5ajzy2rpkMi26) and [curved concrete guardrails](https://goo.gl/maps/4nGewnwYYuPECDwa8) on the sides of this road.
NOTE: This section of road features the Black Dot Mirror.
clues.summary: Steep rocky cliffs with a purple or red tint, almost no vegetation apart from grass and shrubs, a small river beside the road, brown metal pylons and curved concrete guardrails. This stretch has the black dot mirror.

clues.title: Landscape: lots of snow, clear road, hilly
text: On this long stretch of road, you will see plenty of **snow** all around you, except on the road. The Landscape is generally hilly, except the northeastern and southwestern parts, which are in the mountains.
NOTE: Most of this section features the Black Dot Mirror.
clues.summary: Plenty of snow all around except on the road. Mostly hilly, with mountains in the northeast and southwest. Most of it has the black dot mirror.

clues.title: Landscape: rocky cliffs with spruces
text: This section of road goes through mountains that have **rocky cliffs**. These mountains are a habitat for lots of [spruce trees](https://goo.gl/maps/6ykqFWDntTbrPQnX6) that grow on the cliff sides. A more diverse selection of trees grows next to the river that follows the road. You can see that [some mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/ZYdKwBNtUvT3WQH8A) still have snow on the peaks. Most [signposts](https://goo.gl/maps/bRKCMi9bDmj5YCQV6) along the road are coloured blue.
NOTE: The southern section of the road features more rocky cliffs that cannot sustain any trees.
clues.summary: Mountains with rocky cliffs and spruce trees, more varied trees next to the river, some snowy peaks and mostly blue signposts.

clues.title: Landscape: dried-up reservoir, tall mountains
text: You can see the mostly **dried up** part of the Toktogul Reservoir either to the south or north of the road. There are taller mountains quite close on every side. The northern half is more desolate, while the south features more vegetation and buildings as well.
clues.summary: The mostly dried-up part of a big reservoir, seen to the south or north of the road, with tall mountains close on every side. The northern half is more desolate, the south has more plants and buildings.

clues.title: Landscape: reservoir looks like a real lake
text: You will usually see the Toktogul Reservoir north of the road in this section. It now resembles an actual **lake**. The landscape is generally **hilly**, especially to the south.
NOTE: The road is in better condition than the one south of Issyk Kul.
clues.summary: The reservoir is usually north of the road here and looks like an actual lake. The land is hilly, especially to the south. The road is in better shape than the one south of the big lake.

clues.title: Landscape: river gorge, large rocky mountains
text: The road then runs through a **river gorge**, with large, rocky mountains on both sides. It features overcast coverage. A sizable river (the [Naryn](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Naryn_(river))) is usually visible to the north, next to the road.
clues.summary: A road through a river gorge with large rocky mountains on both sides, overcast skies, and a big river, the Naryn, usually to the north.

clues.title: Vegetation: farmland and plants in a flat south
text: This southern region has a lot of **agriculture** and a lot of vegetation on the sides of the roads. The region is generally flat, but the road is very close to the hills that are usually to the north or east. The gaps in the minimap indicate [exceptionally hilly spots](https://goo.gl/maps/jiACiXehCHEDrKs6A).
NOTE: This section of road features the Southern Dirty Mirror.
clues.summary: A southern area with lots of farming and plants by the road. It is mostly flat but the road runs very close to hills, usually north or east. This stretch has the southern dirty mirror.

clues.title: Coverage: overcast and snowy road in the south
text: In the south, this stretch of road northwest of Uzgen is characterised by **overcast** coverage and lots of **snow**.
NOTE: This section of road features the Southern Mirror.
clues.summary: A road northwest of Uzgen with overcast skies and lots of snow, with the southern mirror.

clues.title: Road: grassy median
text: The beginning section of the divided EM-11 has this **grassy median** up until Khun-Chi.
clues.summary: The start of this divided road has a grassy median, up to the town of Khun-Chi.

clues.title: Road lines: wide gap as a median
text: From Khun-Chi to the [intersection ](https://goo.gl/maps/Q3uwC5qMdDACzx5d7)east of Tokmok, the road uses these road lines with a **wide gap** as a median.
clues.summary: Between Khun-Chi and a junction east of Tokmok, the median is just a wide gap between two sets of road lines.

clues.title: Road lines: thinner gap in the median
text: The gap in the road lines gets **thinner** east of that intersection up until this [intersection](https://goo.gl/maps/skcoJg2pJaxbkJHVA) east of Kemin.
clues.summary: East of that junction, the gap between the road lines gets thinner, up to the junction east of Kemin.

clues.title: Road: concrete barrier median
text: From there onwards, **concrete barriers** are used as medians.
clues.summary: From there on, concrete barriers divide the road.

clues.title: Landscape: very dry, small shrubs
text: The road then becomes undivided. This section south of Balykchy is **extremely dry**, with the landscape mostly consisting of **small shrubs**, unless you are next to the [Chu river](https://goo.gl/maps/ywDaNU4WiGsZyf6y8). To the north, you can spot [these mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/LP3YHHgYadZiUXew7) that have clouds hovering above them. Otherwise, there are no clouds in this region.
clues.summary: The road becomes undivided and the land south of Balykchy is extremely dry with mostly small shrubs, unless you are next to a river. Mountains to the north have clouds above them, otherwise it is cloud-free.

clues.title: Landscape: dry valley, mountains both sides
text: Further up the road, you enter a **dry valley** with mountains flanking both sides. There is barely any vegetation - just some shrubs close to the ground. The river next to the road brings some more [greenery](https://goo.gl/maps/QHRbRNePyag8rCWZ7) to the area. In the southern half of this section, you can see this [slightly snowy ridge](https://goo.gl/maps/EXF4khfG7pRPC3hY6) to the north.
clues.summary: A dry valley with mountains on both sides and barely any plants except low shrubs. The river brings some green. In the southern half you see a slightly snowy ridge to the north.

clues.title: Landscape: rocky mountains with trees
text: Going further south, you will reach this next valley, which seems equally dry, but the mountains are more rocky and have **trees** growing on them. The road now has very **bad pavement**, and as such you can see dust clouds.
clues.summary: The next valley is equally dry but the mountains are rockier and have trees. The road has very bad pavement, so you see dust clouds.

clues.title: Landscape: greener, more buildings
text: Once you get out of the valley, you will notice this area is **more vegetated**, has **more buildings**, and more animals on the now grassy fields. The landscape is still hilly, with bigger mountains to the north, south, and west. The southern mountains are especially distinct, with them being covered in snow. The hills immediately north of Naryn can get very dry, but look out for [snow](https://goo.gl/maps/E8fD9vJwmhoBrUfNA) that you can see in the shade.

images.caption: Open grassland beside a paved road; small icons drawn on mark the sun and a zoom

clues.summary: Out of the valley it is more vegetated with more buildings and animals on grassy fields. Hilly with bigger mountains north, south and west, and the southern ones are covered in snow.

clues.title: Landscape: snow on red soil hills
text: The mountains and hills south of Naryn have a unique combination of **snow** and **red soil** that make them very distinct.
clues.summary: Mountains and hills south of Naryn mix snow with red soil, which is very distinctive.

clues.title: Landscape: one distinct ridge south
text: The At-Bashi Valley has a [very distinct mountain range](https://goo.gl/maps/DNxLPk2rgUd5Babu9), which you will see to your south from any section on this road. To the north, you can see [scattered mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/GAaBPtEVnyF3xJAa8) that do not form a uniform ridge. There is also a big set of [hills](https://goo.gl/maps/CHXuEYCMG96zSkoY9) to the west.
clues.summary: A very distinct mountain range always to the south, scattered mountains that do not form a ridge to the north, and a big set of hills to the west.

clues.title: Landscape: sunny, mountains north, lake south
text: The section from Balykchy to Cholpon Ata is **sunny**, with mountains to the north, and a lake to the south.
clues.summary: A sunny stretch with mountains to the north and the lake to the south.

clues.title: Landscape: overcast, tall tree rows, lake south
text: The section east of Cholpon Ata appears **overcast**, with mountains to the north, and a lake to the south. Tall** tree rows** on either side of the road is a common sight.
clues.summary: An overcast stretch with mountains to the north, the lake to the south and tall tree rows on both sides of the road.

clues.title: Vegetation: tall tree rows, snowy mountains
text: The vertical stretch of road north of Karakol is mostly flanked by tall **tree rows** on either side. There are also tall **snowy mountains** to the north and south.
NOTE: The weather changes [here](https://goo.gl/maps/KRut2ZyU5NqN4kSh9), around the midpoint of the road.
clues.summary: A north-south road lined with tall tree rows on both sides, with tall snowy mountains to the north and south. The weather changes around the midpoint.

clues.title: Vegetation: lots of plants
text: On the road west of Karakol, you will see a lot of vegetation on the sides of the roads, and long expanses of green and yellow fields beyond them. You will usually be able to see the [Tian Shan Mountain Range](https://goo.gl/maps/eas6MS21Stbsv2xSA) in the distance to the north. There are [big mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/CADnPrwmSH4cDRNz5) to the south as well, with smaller hills before them.
NOTE: The weather is completely clear east of [this intersection](https://goo.gl/maps/pWreLeU7anq1h2kZ7).
clues.summary: A lot of greenery beside the road and long green and yellow fields behind. The Tian Shan range is usually visible to the north, with big mountains to the south and smaller hills before them.

clues.title: Landscape: lake and mountains, sandy rocky soil
text: You will almost always see the **Issyk Kul lake**, and the [Tian Shan mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/xN3btAAdfLjmejwv8) on this section. The soil here is **sandy and rocky**.
clues.summary: You almost always see the big lake and the Tian Shan mountains here. The soil is sandy and rocky.

clues.title: Coverage: distinct sunset west of the canyon
text: The section west of “Fairytale Canyon” has distinct **sunset** coverage.
clues.summary: The part west of the Fairytale Canyon has clear sunset coverage.

clues.title: Landscape: mountains south, hills north
text: You will see a lot of mountains and hills to the south here, but only some hills to the north, with seemingly nothing behind them. You might even see Issyk Kul behind them. There is still a lot of **sand** on the sides of the roads.
clues.summary: A lot of mountains and hills to the south, only some hills to the north with seemingly nothing behind, though you might spot the lake. There is a lot of sand on the roadsides.

clues.title: Landscape: drier west end of the lake
text: The landscape around the western end of Issyk Kul is **drier** than the east. The lake itself and the southern hills are **further away** from the road as well.
clues.summary: The land around the western end of the lake is drier than in the east, and the lake and the southern hills are further from the road.

clues.title: Landscape: very snowy, uncleared slush
text: This section of EM-17 is **very snowy**. The hills and mountains around the road are almost fully covered in snow. Unlike the other snowy roads, this road is often covered in **uncleared slush** or melted snow.
NOTE: This section of road features the Black Dot Mirror.
clues.summary: Hills and mountains almost fully covered in snow. Unlike other snowy roads, this one is often covered in uncleared slush. This stretch has the black dot mirror.

clues.title: Landscape: snow only on the southern hills
text: Going further west, only the hills to the **south** will have **snow** on them. The landscape is generally dry, with hills to the north and south of the road.
Most of this section features the Black Dot Mirror.
clues.summary: Further west only the hills to the south have snow. The land is dry, with hills north and south of the road. Most of it has the black dot mirror.

clues.title: Road: unpaved gravel between two hilly ridges
text: The road going east of Kazarman is an **unpaved gravel road**, between two **hilly ridges** on either side. The ridge to the north is further away, and has a bigger set of mountains visible behind it. The mountain ridge has a [unique mountain](https://goo.gl/maps/4ho1Xxywx3kqwBb67) that towers above the rest.

images.caption: Red circle marks the distant snowy peaks above the unpaved gravel road between two ridges.

clues.summary: An unpaved gravel road between two hilly ridges. The northern ridge is further away with bigger mountains behind it, and one unique mountain towers above the rest.

clues.title: Road: gravel in a valley, bushes and grass
text: The eastern side of EM-13 closely resembles the road going west of Naryn. (See tip below) This road, however, is an unpaved gravel road in the middle of the Naryn valley, so the hills to the north are now closer. The Landscape is filled with bushes, shrubs, and grass.

NOTE: The one [town](https://goo.gl/maps/1thfQDp4CWjf8LFd6) in the region can be recognized by these [white-and-red fences](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.4501666,74.8385784,3a,19y,34.51h,67.32t,0.03r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1suyOimMFlXHwwDfOq3fpKRQ!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) with a white diamond pattern in the middle.
clues.summary: An unpaved gravel road in the middle of a river valley with hills to the north close by, filled with bushes, shrubs and grass. The one town has white-and-red fences. It looks like the paved road west of Naryn.

clues.title: Landscape: dry valley, hills close on the south
text: This road going west of Naryn is situated south in the **dry** Naryn valley. You will typically see hills **close** to the road on the southern side. There are also bigger mountains not too far behind. While to the north, there is a wide plain, with hills and mountains in the distance. Many parts of the road also have a pavement with a [salt and pepper-like quality](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.4307504,75.7604242,3a,19.2y,69.61h,72.46t,0.49r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sfkTujXcKAOpKC3EtfhN0tg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
clues.summary: West of Naryn, in a dry valley, hills are close to the road on the south side with bigger mountains behind, and a wide plain to the north. Much of the pavement has a salt-and-pepper look.

clues.title: Landscape: more built-up, partly unpaved
text: The road going east of Naryn is also in the Naryn Valley. Here you will also see hills close to the road in the south, and then further away to the north. The plains north of the road are however smaller. This side is also more **built up**, except the road, which is **unpaved** at certain parts. Here, the hills south also have small amounts of snow on them.
clues.summary: East of Naryn, hills are close on the south and farther on the north with smaller plains. It is more built up, and the road is unpaved in places. The hills to the south have small amounts of snow.

clues.title: Landscape: lake in dry rolling hills
text: Song-Kul is the second major lake in Kyrgyzstan. The surrounding area features **dry rolling hills**, with [patches of snow](https://goo.gl/maps/RsdaJzrygRHw2diXA). The only covered road is made of [gravel](https://goo.gl/maps/Esedn3HTkCWHPvU66).
clues.summary: The second biggest lake, Song-Kul, is surrounded by dry rolling hills with patches of snow. The only covered road is gravel.

clues.title: Road: unpaved high road above the clouds
text: The road in the mountains south of Song-Kul is the only unpaved road this **high up** in the mountains. You can see the clouds below you, down in the valleys below. The mountains have rugged peaks, and snowy cliff sides. Many of the mountains also have **spruce trees** growing on them.
clues.summary: The only unpaved road this high up. You can see clouds below in the valleys, rugged peaks, snowy cliffs and spruce trees on many mountains.

clues.title: Landscape: river in a valley to the east
text: On this road, you should be able to see the **Kara Darya river** to the east in the valley below the road. The region is generally hilly and green. To the north, you can see some [low-lying mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/fYZUkPu26QE6tfCQ9) in the distance, they have some snow on them. The hills east of the river have snow on the top as well.
NOTE: This section of road features the Southern Dirty Mirror.
clues.summary: A river runs in the valley below the road to the east, with hilly green land, low snowy mountains to the north and snow on the hilltops east of the river. This stretch has the southern dirty mirror.

clues.title: Landscape: some snow on the ground
text: There will generally be some **snow** on the ground on this road. You will see more snow depending on how north you are. You will often see the massive [Gora Babash-Ata mountain](https://goo.gl/maps/kGtjN6oAmAbvkUze9) to the north.
NOTE: This section of road features the Southern Dirty Mirror.
clues.summary: There is usually some snow on the ground, more the further north you go, and a huge mountain to the north. This stretch has the southern dirty mirror.

clues.title: Landscape: dry and rocky with one visible ridge
text: This section of M-107 is **dry and rocky**. There are a lot of mountains around, but [this one ridge](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.4371677,72.2096491,3a,21.4y,37.6h,94.9t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s_g43tNH_JZ14j9fSIrncTg!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) specifically can be seen from most of this section.

NOTE: This is what [the ridge](https://www.google.com/maps/@41.6308683,72.0703855,3a,15y,123.88h,92.76t,0.97r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sRRet5QctN8yaoLRahjoS3w!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=tts&shorturl=1) looks like from further away.

images.caption: Red oval marks the single visible ridge on the horizon above the dry rocky road.

clues.summary: A dry, rocky stretch with lots of mountains, and one particular ridge visible from most of it.

clues.title: Road: concrete barriers, hilly, lots of plants
text: Going further west, you will encounter a very **hilly** landscape. The landscape features a lot of **vegetation** - tall grass, trees, bushes. This road uses these [concrete barriers](https://goo.gl/maps/KP2sH81R7BDqb2wx5) as guardrails, notice the cement above the gaps.
The general southeast to northwest driving direction on this road is also worth noting.
clues.summary: A very hilly landscape with tall grass, trees and bushes. The road uses concrete barriers as guardrails, with cement above the gaps. The car drives southeast to northwest.

clues.title: Vegetation: leafy valley, poor unpaved road
text: This valley is **full of vegetation**. This area also has a lot of buildings and fences near the road. Most of the road is in poor shape, with it being unpaved and potholes littering parts of it. To the north, you can see some darker clouds, and closer to Arkit, the weather will get cloudier, and there are more dead trees.
The south to north driving direction on this road is worth noting.
clues.summary: A valley full of plants with many buildings and fences by the road. Most of the road is unpaved with potholes. Darker clouds to the north, more cloudy with more dead trees near Arkit. The car drives south to north.

clues.title: Vegetation: snow and low broad-leaved trees
text: This section near Arkit has a lot of **snow** everywhere and **low broad leafed trees** all around. This already unique landscape paired with the south to north driving direction makes it very easy to recognise.
clues.summary: A lot of snow with low broad-leaved trees all around, with the car driving south to north. Very easy to recognise.

clues.title: Landscape: spruce-covered snowy mountains
text: This section of the M-010 is surrounded by beautiful **spruce covered snowy mountains**. Some snow has also gathered on the sides of the road.
clues.summary: Snowy mountains covered with spruce trees on the M-010, with some snow on the roadsides.

clues.title: Road: rocky dirt road high in snowy hills
text: This **rocky dirt road** going to Chunkurchak is mostly high up in the snowy hills south of Bishkek. Some of the soil here has a **red tint** to it. On the [northern part](https://goo.gl/maps/v18zEDkdyTZVXwjc8) of the road, you can only see the snowy hills to the south. Also pay attention to the [red-and-white bollards](https://goo.gl/maps/fWt1rsU4FZ8wA5Z47) on the sides of the roads.

images.caption: Rocky snow-covered mountain road; the red circle zooms in on a roadside pole

clues.summary: A rocky dirt road high in the snowy hills south of the capital. Some soil has a red tint, the north part only shows snowy hills to the south, and the roadside has red-and-white bollards.

clues.title: Landscape: rocky valley with varied plants
text: There is another road with coverage to the east of the Chunkurchak road: it goes through a very **rocky valley**, with a variety of plants growing on the mountainsides, of which only some have small amounts of snow. You can also see some snow in the valley, and more so towards the south.
clues.summary: A road through a very rocky valley with a variety of plants on the mountainsides, some with a little snow, more snow towards the south.

clues.title: Road: snowy mountains in every direction
text: You can easily recognise this side road, labelled as A367 on the map, from the snow covered mountain ranges in **every** direction. The sun to the south is almost blinding.
NOTE: This section of road features the Black Dot Mirror.
clues.summary: A side road with snow-covered mountain ranges in every direction and an almost blinding sun to the south. This stretch has the black dot mirror.

clues.title: Road: yellow-and-black kerbs on the median
text: This divided road north of Bishkek, that leads up to the international airport, uses unique **yellow-and-black curbs** on the median, which consists of mostly grass. Some sections have small planted trees, and poles with red-and-yellow paint on the bottom. The [horizontal section](https://goo.gl/maps/3NtVfKr8wvp3ibU48) west of the airport has a lot more trees.

images.caption: Road median with yellow-and-black kerbs, left of the road

clues.summary: A divided road leading to the international airport with yellow-and-black kerbs on a mostly grassy median, some small planted trees and poles with red-and-yellow paint at the bottom. The part west of the airport has more trees.

clues.title: Coverage: sunset on a northeast road
text: This slightly northeast-bound road north of Bishkek can easily be recognised from the **sunset** coverage.
clues.summary: A road heading slightly northeast, north of the capital, has sunset coverage that makes it easy to recognise.

clues.title: Landscape: very green valley
text: The road south of Jeti Oguz goes through a valley. The general landscape in this valley is **very green** by Kyrgyzstan standards, there are plenty of trees and bushes growing in the valley and on the hills. You can see small patches of snow still on the ground. From most of the valley, you can still see the [Tian Shan mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/n5nMitgC1Zx3N7H69) to the north, and other snowy mountains to the south. The valley also contains these [unique orange rock formations](https://goo.gl/maps/b1a7ct7RJ3iedLDPA).
clues.summary: A valley that is very green for the country, with many trees and bushes, small patches of snow, the Tian Shan mountains to the north and other snowy mountains to the south.

clues.title: Landscape: river valley with spruce mountains
text: The road north of Grigorievka goes through a stunning river valley. This is one of the most unique roads in Kyrgyzstan. You can easily recognise it from the **spruce covered mountains** in this rocky valley. The lack of snow is also notable.

The [northern half](https://www.google.com/maps/@42.8331837,77.4143633,2a,90y,134.55h,91.08t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1s7LGOZHJ1Tx8HoLdqRrNNMA!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3D7LGOZHJ1Tx8HoLdqRrNNMA%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D36.16604%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) of this road is on an open rolling field with pine forests scattered around.
clues.summary: A river valley in a rocky area with spruce-covered mountains and no snow. One of the most distinctive roads in the country.

clues.title: Road: well-kept road through dry mountains
text: There is a side road north of the Orto Tokoy Reservoir that has very broken coverage. This road is **well maintained**, and it passes through **dry mountains**. The only vegetation around is grass and shrubs. To the west, you can see this [mountain](https://goo.gl/maps/EYX6oJnUFHhxN89P8) which has little snow left. To the north, the [mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/NP7X99RuTAnMVSNu5) are dark, similar to silhouettes, and on the southern portion of the road, you will see the [reservoir](https://goo.gl/maps/tqBo8qMqdCXkZhjT9).
clues.summary: A side road with broken coverage, well maintained, through dry mountains with only grass and shrubs. One mountain to the west has little snow left, and mountains to the north look dark like silhouettes.

clues.title: Road: remote gravel road in a dry
text: This remote gravel road southwest of Naryn passes through a **dry and desolate valley**. Despite the river, there is nothing but some shrubs on the ground. Many of the mountains in the valley have steep, rocky cliff sides. You will also find snow here, but more so in the south.
clues.summary: A remote gravel road through a dry valley with only shrubs despite a river. Many mountains have steep rocky sides. There is snow, more so in the south.
